recommended_edit: Because the shared affordance is an immutable numeric bound, re-present the small terminal set indirectly through the facility scenario rather than advertising it as the central algorithmic parameter; in particular, remove the explanatory language that frames the problem as a small-terminal Steiner-tree instance and describe critical chambers as a dynamically designated safety set.
regression_risk: This may make the intended connectivity interpretation less explicit and could restore models that previously failed by misunderstanding the physical transitivity.
